issue.body:
## Problem

`sample-kit sync --help` says `Pushes local changes to the remote.` Sync only pulls.

## Fix

Change the help line to `Pulls remote changes into the local cache.`

## Done when

- [ ] `sync --help` prints the new line.

Out of scope: any change to how sync behaves.

pr.title: docs(sample-kit): correct the sync help text
pr.body: Fixes the sync help line to say it pulls.
